description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawns, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
